method: Direct official DOE Genesis news listings; no Google News

items.title: Genesis Mission Hackathon brings research community together to build future of science
items.summary: Over 450 attendees participated in the Genesis Mission Hackathon, developing a strong starting point for integrating their scientific workflows into the Genesis Mission Platform.

items.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ Release to Support Innovation Across the Genesis Mission
items.summary: New public software release gives researchers plain-language access to reusable guidance and tools for building, evaluating, and improving Super Intelligence (SI) enabled systems

items.title: FACT SHEET: The Energy Department is Ushering in a Golden Age of American Science
items.summary: The Trump Administration is Accelerating Scientific Discovery, Securing American Technological Leadership, and Building the Next Generation of American Scientists

items.title: Energy Department Announces New Genesis Mission Awards to Advance Super Intelligence for Science
items.summary: Twelve newly selected Phase II and six Phase I projects to advance the frontiers of Super Intelligence (SI) for science, capping a first-year cohort of 297 projects across the Genesis Mission portfolio.

items.title: Energy Department Launches Genesis Mission Graduate Fellowship to Advance American Scientific Leadership
items.summary: Inaugural fellowship program aims to build a robust domestic, Super Intelligence (SI)-ready scientific workforce through dual-competency training and research experiences at DOE National Labs and with industry partners.

items.title: DOE Announces Science Applications for Quantum Computing
items.summary: Key scientific utility problems will guide Quantum Genesis’s goal of developing fault-tolerant scientifically relevant quantum computers.

items.title: DOE Launches Competition to Accelerate Development of World’s First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computer
items.summary: Applicants are invited to submit proposals for the Quantum Genesis Q competition.

items.title: DOE Office of Electricity Announces $11.5M Genesis Mission GridFM 2.0 Project
items.summary: Brookhaven-led research project to develop foundation models for electric-grid planning and expanding electricity demand.

items.title: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative – Apply Now!
items.summary: By releasing models with open-weights, DOE seeks to galvanize the scientific and AI communities around shared infrastructure for science.

items.title: Secretary of Energy Chris Wright Announces First Genesis Mission Projects Selected to Accelerate AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
items.summary: Nearly 300 projects selected from historic RFA response spanning all 50 states to accelerate breakthroughs in energy, discovery science, and national security.

items.title: United States and Japan Announce Historic $1 Billion Partnership Under President Trump’s Genesis Mission
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy and Japan’s Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, today announced an historic $1 billion strategic partnership making Japan the first international partner in President Trump’s Genesis Mission.

items.title: Energy Department Announces $293 Million in Funding to Support Genesis Mission National Science and Technology Challenges
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy today announced funding to advance the Genesis Mission’s efforts to tackle the nation’s most complex science and technology challenges.

items.title: Energy Department Announces 26 Genesis Mission Science and Technology Challenges to Accelerate AI-Enabled American Innovation and Leadership
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy today announced 26 science and technology challenges of national importance to advance the Genesis Mission and accelerate innovation and discovery through artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: Energy Department Launches ‘Genesis Mission’ to Transform American Science and Innovation Through the AI Computing Revolution
items.summary: President Trump today issued an Executive Order to launch the Genesis Mission, a historic national effort led by the Department of Energy.
